subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt recall, capture, compaction, dreaming, and userModel, including per-agent overrides and the proposed legacy-memory doctor migration, as the durable public memory plugin contract?
rationale: Automated checks can verify implementation consistency, but cannot choose the permanent role taxonomy, initial public scope, or compatibility window.

options.title: Adopt all five roles
options.body: Approve the full taxonomy and per-agent scope after generated docs and exact-head proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow the first contract
options.body: Land only the roles and scope maintainers are ready to support permanently, deferring the rest.

options.title: Pause for another API
options.body: Keep the single-owner model until a different composition or capability contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Adopt all five roles
recommendation.body: Approve the full taxonomy and per-agent scope after generated docs and exact-head proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest sampled ownership history across the central plugin, memory-state, config, and Control UI surfaces.
